description_for_human: Audit any URL for Generative Engine Optimization readiness. Returns an AI visibility score, a 25-category breakdown, and fix recommendations.
description_for_model: Plugin for auditing a website's GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) readiness. Given a URL, returns a 0-100 AI visibility score, category-level scores across 25 dimensions (HTTPS, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, semantic HTML, structured data, authority, AI answer formats, etc.), and actionable fix recommendations. Use when the user asks how well a site is optimized for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Google AI Overviews.
